prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
competitors_mentioned: Five Star Painting of St. Louis
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” painter for every project, but **St. Louis Painting Company** looks like a strong place to start: it reports a **4.9/5 rating across 383+ Google reviews** and says it is accredited by the Painting Contractors Association and the BBB. [Company website](https://snlpainting.com/)

**Five Star Painting of St. Louis** is another option to compare; its site reports **4.9/5 from 648 customer reviews** and lists service in St. Louis, Chesterfield, and Wildwood. [Company website](https://www.fivestarpainting.com/st-louis/)

Before choosing, get written estimates from at least two companies and compare prep work, paint and materials, schedule, insurance, and warranty—not just the total price. Ratings and review counts can change, so check recent reviews and confirm the company serves your specific address.
